_doc: Signature spells per spec and hybrid (user rule 2026-10-22: 'The specs should use the spells that make that spec, that spec. Especially the hybrid ones'; strictness 'main damage', leveling and raid). Keys: the spec as spec_modes.spec_of names it (a tree, or 'Hybrid A/B'). `required`: never vetoed, dropped or gated off by a rotation search (rotation_opt.py, apl_opt.py), and cast in every fight from the level it is learned (trainer level or the talent's level in the build's order); a search keeps the talents that grant them. `core`: these sources (spell names; 'pet' = the pet's or demon's damage, 'melee' = white melee swings, 'Auto Shot' = ranged white) must together carry at least `min_share` of the build's damage (at level 60 for leveling, in the full raid for raid); a build below it is not shown for this spec. `modes` overrides per mode. A spec that plays its signature spells and comes out slower is shown slower: the rule is about what the spec is, not about speed. Optional keys (leveling checks, signature.py): `min_casts` {spell: casts per kill} (a spell listed there is checked at that rate from its learn level, whether or not it is required: reactive or proc spells such as Mongoose Bite or Missile Barrage's Arcane Missiles), `enabled_by` {spell: talent} (counted from the level the talent arrives in the build's order), `grace_levels` {spell: levels} (counted that many levels after it is learned). `demon`: the spec is about the benefit of its demon, not the demon's damage (Demonology, user 2026-10-23): a demon stays in play (summoned or sacrificed) and the demon setup is the best measured one; no share floor.

Balance.note: a Moonkin caster (raid: Starfire and Moonfire; Wrath is optional)

Feral Combat.note: Cat Form (Bear Form at 10-19 while leveling); Shred needs the mob's back, so solo it is the stealth opener only; 2026-11-06 (user decision on page-audit K6): the stealth openers Ravage and Pounce are cat spells and count (Ravage alone is 16% of a leveling cat's damage, and every cat build sat at 80.5-81% against the 80% floor without it)

Beast Mastery.note: the pet is the damage; 2026-11-06 (user decision on page-audit K6): the leveling floor is the raid's 30% (35% before: the leveling builds sat at 34-36%, a pass or fail on one point of noise)

Survival.note: the melee hunter; user 2026-10-24: 'melee hunter doesn't NEED to use Mongoose bite, it just simply need to have majority of it attacks melee ... if the best spec is the 16/11/24 spec or whatever it was that is fine': no required spell, only the melee share; 2026-11-06 (user decision, the one-tree Survival search): while leveling the pet counts, as in the Beast-Survival rule. The pet fights in melee beside the hunter; without it the fastest one-tree build (8/13/30) read 34% and only a build forced to drop Serpent Sting and Immolation Trap passed, 10% slower per kill. The raid rule is unchanged

Hybrid Marksmanship/Survival.note: Melee (split); user 2026-10-24: 'melee hunter doesn't NEED to use Mongoose bite, it just simply need to have majority of it attacks melee ... if the best spec is the 16/11/24 spec or whatever it was that is fine': no required spell, only the melee share

Hybrid Beast Mastery/Survival.note: Beast-Survival: melee with Beast Mastery's aspect and pet talents; Summon Hawk with Lone Wolf in a raid; user 2026-10-24: 'melee hunter doesn't NEED to use Mongoose bite, it just simply need to have majority of it attacks melee ... if the best spec is the 16/11/24 spec or whatever it was that is fine': no required spell, only the melee share

Hybrid Arcane/Frost.note: Missile Barrage with Shatter and Fingers of Frost

Hybrid Fire/Frost.note: Frostfire: built around Frostfire Bolt (trained at 40; Frostbolt before); about a third of the damage, Ice Lance and Fire Blast the rest

Hybrid Holy/Retribution.note: Shockadin: Holy Shock on cooldown, first in the priority. Raid (user decision 2026-10-30): cast on at least 90% of its cooldowns (10 s: 18 casts in the 180 s fight), not a damage share (gear and trinkets move the share; the 12% stand-in failed shockadin-open-raid at 11.8% with Holy Shock on every cooldown). Leveling keeps the 12% share.

Holy.note: leveling as Holy: Smite and Holy Fire, not a wand rotation

Discipline.note: leveling as Discipline: Penance and Smite

Combat.note: Combat's weapon talents: swords play Sinister Strike, daggers Backstab

Subtlety.note: Hemorrhage as the builder; Death Mark, the 31-point finisher of the 2026-11-02 tree (user, 2026-11-03: every spec plays its signature spell). Raid: Hemorrhage only until the raid simulator ports the rogue's 2026-11-02 tree (no Death Mark there yet)

Hybrid Combat/Subtlety.note: Combat-Subtlety: Subtlety's Ghostly Strike and openers

Hybrid Elemental/Enhancement.note: leveling: a Lightning Bolt caster; raid: a melee shaman (spec_modes.HYBRID_NAMES)

Affliction.note: dots; in a raid a Shadow Bolt filler (Nightfall) carries half the damage, so the dots' floor is 30% there

Demonology.note: user 2026-10-23: 'Demonology should just be based around getting the most benefit from the demon, it doesn't need to do the most damage particularly': no damage floor for the demon (its share is reported, not enforced); the build keeps a demon in play, out or sacrificed, with the demon setup that gives the most. Raid: the entry's Succubus out with the Imp sacrificed through Demonic Pact led all 20 demon choices by 7% (full raid, 30f67f5, race-neutral, 2026-10-23); leveling: the Voidwalker, the one demon that tanks

Destruction.note: direct Destruction spells (Shadow Bolt or the fire spells)
